sloka: अक्षौहिण्यो हि तत्रासन्राघवार्थे समुद्यताः ।भरतस्याज्ञया ऽनेकाः प्रहृष्टा बलवाहनाः ।। ७.३९.२ ॥
transliteration: akṣauhiṇyo hi tatrāsanrāghavārthe samudyatāḥ ।bharatasyājñayā 'nekāḥ prahṛṣṭā balavāhanāḥ ।। 7.39.2 ॥

translations.english: Many Akshauhinis, with their delighted forces and vehicles, were indeed present there, prepared for Rama's cause by Bharata's command.
